classification.difficultyReason: Partition weekly hours across normal pay and two successive overtime rates, then combine the earnings.

content.prompt: Stephen earns an hourly rate of \$17.30 for the first 38 hours, time and a half for the next 3 hours and double time for each extra hour above that. Calculate his earnings if he works 44 hours in a week.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Double-time hours} &= 44-38-3=3\\\text{Normal pay} &= 17.30\times38=\$657.40\\\text{Time-and-a-half pay} &= 17.30\times3\times1.5=\$77.85\\\text{Double-time pay} &= 17.30\times3\times2=\$103.80\\\text{Total pay} &= 657.40+77.85+103.80\\\text{Total pay} &= \$839.05\end{align*}$$
